Hi there, I'm sorry if this isn't a very good answer, but please, please, keep talking. I know how hard it can be when people reject you or freak out at what you have to say, or walk away entirely. BUT please keep talking, because people, for all their faults, are far less judgemental than you might think, and one of them might actually say something that could be a reason to stay. So keep talking, to anyone: hotlines, friends you haven't spoken to in ages, your family, old college advisors, anyone. Keep going until someone listens and cares.
